name: Flask App CI

# Kapan aksi ini dijalankan? Setiap ada push atau pull request ke branch 'main'
on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest # Menggunakan server virtual Ubuntu milik GitHub

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: "3.10" # Versi Python yang digunakan

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run Tests with pytest
      env:
        OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }} # Mengambil API key dari rahasia GitHub
      run: |
        pytest test_app.py -v
